evals.prompt: /ce-update -- is my ce-datascience plugin current? I installed it from the marketplace a couple months ago.
evals.expected_output: Compares the loaded marketplace-cache version against upstream plugin.json on main and either confirms it is up to date or gives the claude plugin update command with the derived marketplace name.
expectations: Compares the currently loaded version (from the skill directory path) with the upstream plugins/ce-datascience/.claude-plugin/plugin.json version on main, not a release tag
If versions match, reports 'ce-datascience vX is installed and up to date'
If stale, recommends 'claude plugin update ce-datascience@<marketplace-name>' with the marketplace name derived from the path, then restart

evals.prompt: /ce-update -- I'm in Codex. I installed CE DataScience with bash install.sh codex last month. How do I get the latest version?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a non-Claude harness, does not claim a version comparison, and gives the Codex marketplace upgrade command plus the bunx command that refreshes the generated agents.
expectations: Does not claim to compare installed and upstream versions, since Codex does not expose the installed version to the skill
Gives 'codex plugin marketplace upgrade ce-datascience-plugin' and says to restart Codex
Gives 'bunx ce-datascience-plugin@latest install ce-datascience --to codex' for the generated agents
States that updating keeps the user's own skills and does not tell them to move or delete anything

evals.prompt: /ce-update -- gh isn't authenticated on this machine and I'm on a hospital network that blocks api.github.com.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the upstream version could not be fetched, still gives the Claude update command, and does not guess a version or mutate caches.
expectations: Recognizes the __CE_UPDATE_VERSION_FAILED__ sentinel and tells the user the upstream version could not be fetched
Does not guess the latest version
Still gives 'claude plugin update ce-datascience@<marketplace-name>' as the command to run once the network allows
Does not attempt to mutate plugin caches or marketplace directories as a workaround
